name: BLOCK-T601
configuration_schema:
$schema: http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#
title: BLOCK-T601 configuration
description: Configuration for BLOCK-T601.
type: object
properties:
  sequence_name:
    description: sequence name used for setup_calsys_flats
    type: string
    default: 'whitelight_u_source'
  use_electrometer:
    description: override for mtcalsys use_electrometer
    type: boolean
    default: True
  ignore:
    description: Name of the CSCs we want to ignore
    type: array
    default: ['TunableLaser','CBP','Electrometer:101','Electrometer:102']
